title: Cognizance 2026: 24-Hour AI & Web Hackathon
description: Collaborate with fellow engineers to build full-stack web solutions and generative AI prototypes for real-world campus problems. Exciting cash rewards and internship sponsorships.

title: Hands-On Cloud Architecture & Docker Masterclass
description: Learn container orchestration, microservices deployment, and CI/CD pipelines guided by industry cloud architects from AWS & Google Cloud.

title: Spandan 2026: Annual Youth & Drama Festival
description: Inter-college street plays, classical music nights, and battle of the bands. Open to all students across faculties with certificates of merit.

title: Charusat Premier Cricket & Badminton League
description: Departmental league fixtures for boys and girls teams. Fixtures, jersey kits, and match schedules will be issued upon registration confirmation.

title: Web Dev Workshop: React & Node.js Bootcamp
description: A full-day hands-on workshop covering React hooks, REST APIs with Node.js and Express, and deployment on Render. Bring your laptop.

title: Navratri Garba Night 2026
description: Join the university's biggest cultural gathering for nine nights of traditional Garba and Dandiya. Traditional attire encouraged. Entry with college ID.

title: Inter-Department Football Championship
description: Annual football tournament open to all departments. Register your squad of 11 players. Trophies and medals for top three finishing teams.

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Workshop
description: Explore penetration testing techniques, OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities, and how to use tools like Burp Suite and Metasploit in a legal lab environment.

title: Annual Classical Music & Dance Recital
description: Students from the performing arts club present Bharatanatyam, Kathak, and Hindustani classical vocal performances. Free entry for all students.

title: Data Science & ML Hackathon
description: A 12-hour competitive event where teams of two to three build machine learning models on real datasets. Prizes include cloud credits and internship offers.

title: Table Tennis Open Tournament
description: Singles and doubles categories open for all enrolled students. Register individually or as a pair. Rackets available on loan at the sports office.

title: Photography & Short Film Festival
description: Submit your campus photographs and short films (up to 5 minutes) for judging by faculty and alumni. Best entries will be displayed permanently in the gallery.

title: Python & Django Workshop for Beginners
description: Learn to build and deploy a complete web application with Python and Django. No prior Python experience required. All materials provided.

title: Annual Athletic Meet 2026
description: Track and field events including 100m, 400m, relay races, long jump, and shot put. Represent your department and win overall championship shield.

title: Farewell & Cultural Evening 2026
description: A grand evening hosted by the student council to celebrate the graduating batch, featuring performances, awards, and a formal dinner for all final year students.
